title: Add PUT to CORS allowed methods in gateway
description:
**Bug**: `core/controlplane/gateway/gateway.go:2472` sets CORS `Access-Control-Allow-Methods` to `"GET, POST, DELETE, OPTIONS"` but the router registers `PUT /api/v1/policy/bundles/{id}` at line 1002. Browsers block PUT requests because the CORS preflight fails.

**Fix**: Change line 2472 to include PUT:
```go
w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS")
```

**Files**: `core/controlplane/gateway/gateway.go`
definitionOfDone: PUT is included in Access-Control-Allow-Methods header

implementationPlan.description:
In `core/controlplane/gateway/gateway.go`, find the CORS middleware (around line 2472) and change:
```go
w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, DELETE, OPTIONS")
```
To:
```go
w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS")
```
Update any existing CORS tests to verify PUT is in the allowed methods.
